rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides comprehensive DNS security analysis tooling for cybersecurity practitioners. Includes DNSSEC chain-of-trust validation, SPF/DKIM/DMARC/BIMI/MTA-STS email authentication checks, RDAP domain registration lookups, DNS-based threat intelligence (RBL, DBL, ASN, fast-flux detection), and reverse DNS verification. Ships with structured analyst prompts for automated email security audits, DNSSEC chain audits, and phishing forensics workflows.
